description: Aggregates and analyzes bank account statements to extract financial health metrics for individual borrowers and businesses. Fetches transaction history directly from banks via the RBI Account Aggregator (AA) framework with customer consent, or via bank statement PDF parsing. Provides income estimation, average balance, bounce rate, EMI obligation detection, and spending category breakdown. Widely used in digital lending for bank statement analysis and income proof verification without requiring physical document uploads.
use_cases: Bank statement analysis for income verification
Monthly salary and income estimation for loan eligibility
EMI obligation detection to assess existing debt burden
Average monthly balance check for creditworthiness
Bounce rate analysis to detect financial stress
Cash flow assessment for MSME and business loans
Spending pattern analysis for affordability assessment
compliance_context: RBI Account Aggregator framework (Master Direction 2016). Explicit digital consent required. NBFC-AA licensed framework. Data minimization and purpose limitation apply.
typical_callers: Digital lenders, NBFC underwriting teams, personal finance apps, MSME lending platforms, co-lending originators
auth_description: OAuth2 client credentials flow. Client ID and secret used to obtain access token.

required_fields.description: Start date of statement analysis period
End date of statement analysis period
RBI AA signed consent JWT token

optional_fields.description: Run ML category tagging on each transaction

error_codes.400: Invalid date range or malformed consent artifact.
